summary: ASX 200 fell 1.0% to a six-week low of 8,920.8 as a -5.2% consumer-sentiment collapse and Westpac's November hike call (to 4.60%) drove a defensive rotation. Utilities/health/energy green; financials (-1.6%), IT (-1.8%) and consumer disc (-1.9%) led losses. SRL +21.19% on FY results; AEL +12.31% on the Juliet-1 gas hit; CXO +6.06% on first Finniss spodumene. Oil at a four-month high on Saudi strikes.
